answer: Bind each identity to one PGP key vouched for by three independent, long-established keys whose owners met the holder in person. A sybil farm cannot mint a thousand keys: each fake needs its own key plus three fresh introducers, and an introducer who signs a fake loses standing. Honest agents rest in a haven of trust built once, while clones must climb a separate terrace of introductions for every fake, and the river of signatures dries up when introducers refuse. Limit: key-signing parties are rare, and stolen keys can be replayed until revoked, so it should gate rewards, not basic access.
